_not: SEFER DÜŞMANI SKILL SESLERİ (Ömer 2026-10-16): her mob skill'inin KENDİ sesi (artık bir class'ın sesini ödünç almaz). Şema data/audio.json > sfx ile aynı (+ label/desc, Codex > Assets > Sounds > Campaign enemies). Oynatma src/game/mob-sfx.ts: efektin (ödünç v1/v2 ya da mob sheet'i) c.sfx(id) isteği `roles` ile role çevrilir (cast = hazırlık/savurma, travel = uçuş, hit = vuruş, none = sessiz; skill bazında `skills.<id>.roles` ezer), o rolün kendi sesi çalar; aynı ses bir döküm içinde 90 ms'den sık çalmaz. Skill burada yoksa eski ödünç ses (skills.json > sfx) çalar. Kazançlar tepe ölçümüyle class skill seslerine eşitlendi.

mobPowderKegCast.desc: A slow-match touches the fuse of a small cask; it sputters and the keg is lobbed

mobPowderKegHit.label: Powder Keg: blast
mobPowderKegHit.desc: Black powder bursts: a deep bang, oak staves splinter and burning grit pelts the ground

mobQueensLamentCast.label: Queen's Lament: keening song
mobQueensLamentCast.desc: The Siren Queen sings a high, sorrowful keen that bends downward

mobQueensLamentHit.label: Queen's Lament: chill of the deep
mobQueensLamentHit.desc: The song lands as a cold, sinking breath of seawater around the target

mobGrandChorusCast.label: Grand Chorus: siren choir
mobGrandChorusCast.desc: Many siren voices rise together in a swelling close-harmony chord

mobGrandChorusHit.label: Grand Chorus: undertow
mobGrandChorusHit.desc: The chord breaks into a dragging undertow of churning water

mobSirensCallCast.label: Siren's Call: luring call
mobSirensCallCast.desc: A single soft, breathy siren voice calls a rising two-note phrase

mobSirensCallHit.label: Siren's Call: enthralled
mobSirensCallHit.desc: A hush of surf closes over the target's ears like a held breath

mobBrineRiteCast.label: Brine Rite: intonation
mobBrineRiteCast.desc: The bishop's low intonation as a brass aspergillum flicks brine

mobBrineRiteHit.label: Brine Rite: salt stings
mobBrineRiteHit.desc: Holy brine spatters the target and salt sizzles in open cuts

mobRequiemOfSaltCast.label: Requiem of Salt: requiem
mobRequiemOfSaltCast.desc: A deep, slow requiem from the bishop and his drowned acolytes

mobRequiemOfSaltHit.label: Requiem of Salt: salt flood
mobRequiemOfSaltHit.desc: A column of brine rushes in, crusted with grinding salt

mobTideOfMercyCast.label: Tide of Mercy: gentle tide
mobTideOfMercyCast.desc: A soft wave laps in and draws back over pebbles while the bishop hums a blessing

mobDrownedGreatswordCast.label: Drowned Greatsword: heavy swing
mobDrownedGreatswordCast.desc: A huge waterlogged two-hander is swung slowly, shedding water as it goes

mobDrownedGreatswordHit.label: Drowned Greatsword: cleave
mobDrownedGreatswordHit.desc: The rust-pitted blade bites deep with a heavy crunch and a splash

mobChampionsChallengeCast.label: Champion's Challenge: blade on breastplate
mobChampionsChallengeCast.desc: The champion beats the flat of his greatsword on his breastplate three times

mobChampionsChallengeHit.label: Champion's Challenge: drowned roar
mobChampionsChallengeHit.desc: A deep, gurgling roar through a helm full of water

mobWallOfBrineCast.label: Wall of Brine: shield raised
mobWallOfBrineCast.desc: A barnacled tower shield is heaved up with a scrape of shells

mobWallOfBrineHit.label: Wall of Brine: water wall
mobWallOfBrineHit.desc: The shield plants in the wet ground and a sheet of seawater rises behind it

mobWyrmLashCast.label: Lash: tail rises
mobWyrmLashCast.desc: A huge eel-like tail slithers wetly and whips up out of the water

mobWyrmLashHit.label: Lash: tail slap
mobWyrmLashHit.desc: The tail slams down across the line like a falling mast, spraying water

mobWyrmSwallowCast.label: Swallow: jaws gape
mobWyrmSwallowCast.desc: The wyrm rears out of the water, its jaws opening with a wet, gargling hiss

mobWyrmSwallowHit.label: Swallow: snap and gulp
mobWyrmSwallowHit.desc: Great jaws snap shut, then a deep, wet gulp

mobWyrmSurgeCast.label: Surge: wyrm dives
mobWyrmSurgeCast.desc: The wyrm's bulk rolls under with a long, heavy surge of displaced water

mobWyrmSurgeHit.label: Surge: bow wave crashes
mobWyrmSurgeHit.desc: A wall of water bursts up under the heroes and crashes over the cells

mobWyrmDelugeCast.label: Deluge: wyrm roars
mobWyrmDelugeCast.desc: A long, bellowing roar from the wyrm that shakes the whole weir

mobWyrmDelugeHit.label: Deluge: the weir bursts
mobWyrmDelugeHit.desc: The weir gives way: a roaring torrent floods the whole field, timbers tumbling in it

mobCutlassFlurryCast.label: Cutlass Flurry: twin cuts
mobCutlassFlurryCast.desc: An admiral's fine cutlass whips twice, fast and precise

mobCutlassFlurryHit.label: Cutlass Flurry: two slashes
mobCutlassFlurryHit.desc: Two crisp, quick slices, the second deeper than the first

mobChainShotCast.label: Chain Shot: gun fires
mobChainShotCast.desc: A deck gun fires: a hard bang, then the whirring howl of two balls on a chain

mobChainShotHit.label: Chain Shot: scythes the column
mobChainShotHit.desc: The spinning chain scythes down the column, snapping wood and tearing cloth

mobHarpoonLineCast.label: Harpoon Line: harpoon hurled
mobHarpoonLineCast.desc: A barbed whaling harpoon is hurled; its line whips off the coil with a rising hiss

mobHarpoonLineHit.label: Harpoon Line: barb and haul
mobHarpoonLineHit.desc: The harpoon thunks home, the line twangs taut and the victim is hauled in

mobVaneRallyCast.label: Rally: hilt on the rail
mobVaneRallyCast.desc: Admiral Vane raps his cutlass hilt twice on the ship's oak rail

mobVaneRallyHit.label: Rally: 'All hands!'
mobVaneRallyHit.desc: A commanding naval shout, answered by a rough cheer from the crew

mobBroadsideCast.label: Broadside: 'Fire!'
mobBroadsideCast.desc: Linstocks hiss at the touch-holes as the gun captain bellows the order

mobBroadsideHit.label: Broadside: rolling cannon fire
mobBroadsideHit.desc: Three cannons fire in a ragged, rolling volley, round shot smashing into the row

mobBrineLashCast.label: Brine Lash: water whip
mobBrineLashCast.desc: The Queen draws a whip of seawater out of the air; it cracks like wet leather

mobBrineLashHit.label: Brine Lash: wet strike
mobBrineLashHit.desc: The water whip strikes and bursts into cold spray

mobHighTideCast.label: High Tide: the tide climbs
mobHighTideCast.desc: Water swells and climbs around the marked cells with a long, rising roar

mobHighTideHit.label: High Tide: wave breaks
mobHighTideHit.desc: A heavy wave breaks over the marked cells and drains away hissing

mobLamentOfTheDeepCast.label: Lament of the Deep: the Queen's dirge
mobLamentOfTheDeepCast.desc: The Drowned Queen sings low and regal while a drowned court hums beneath her

mobLamentOfTheDeepHit.label: Lament of the Deep: pressure of the deep
mobLamentOfTheDeepHit.desc: A heavy, muffled pressure like sinking into deep water, with bubbles rising past

mobTheReachDrownsCast.label: The Reach Drowns: the sea is called
mobTheReachDrownsCast.desc: The Queen's long, commanding cry; far off, the whole sea answers with a growing roar

mobTheReachDrownsHit.label: The Reach Drowns: flood
mobTheReachDrownsHit.desc: A colossal wave swallows the whole side: a crushing boom, roaring water, then a deep churn

mobPitCestusHit.label: Iron Cestus: haymaker
mobPitCestusHit.desc: A spiked, iron-bound fist swings in with a grunt and crunches into a jaw: a thick, meaty thud with a rattle of studs

mobSkullSplitterCast.label: Skull Splitter: overhead heave
mobSkullSplitterCast.desc: Gorr hoists his spiked pit club overhead with a roar

mobSkullSplitterHit.label: Skull Splitter: the crowd gasps
mobSkullSplitterHit.desc: The club cracks down on a helm with a stunning thunk; the crowd gasps 'Ohh!'

mobPlayToTheCrowdCast.label: Play to the Crowd: chest beat
mobPlayToTheCrowdCast.desc: Gorr pounds his chest twice and the pit crowd stamps along

mobPlayToTheCrowdHit.label: Play to the Crowd: 'GORR!'
mobPlayToTheCrowdHit.desc: A bellowed challenge, answered by the crowd chanting his name
